picks.title: Google AI writes positive-only review summaries into Search ads in 4 markets
picks.rationale: Google's AI now writes review-summary copy into advertisers' Search ads in four markets. Advertisers can't edit it, and the help page gives no opt-out, so it changes what ad creative actually serves.
picks.excerpt: Google is inserting AI-generated, positive-only review summaries into Search ads in four markets. Advertisers cannot edit the text, which Google shows only when it predicts better ad performance; the help page omits opt-out and sourcing details.

picks.title: Google Ads expands Smart Bidding Exploration to Performance Max and Shopping campaigns
picks.rationale: AI bidding can now loosen ROAS targets by 5-30% to chase extra conversions in PMax and Shopping. That is a new bidding control advertisers have to decide on, and portfolio strategies switch it off.
picks.excerpt: Google's Smart Bidding Exploration, which lets AI bidding loosen ROAS targets (5-30% tolerance) to chase additional conversions, now extends to Performance Max and Shopping campaigns; portfolio bid strategies switch it off.

picks.title: Google Ads AI tool copies Search campaigns into 10 new languages
picks.rationale: Google's AI localization tool now clones English (US) Search campaigns into 10 more languages. Budgets copy over without currency conversion, which is a practical trap for anyone expanding paid search across markets.
picks.excerpt: Google Ads' AI localization tool now copies English (US) Search campaigns into 10 new languages; budgets copy across with no currency conversion, and promised Performance Max support has yet to be confirmed.

picks.title: Cybersecurity bounty hunter says Samsung TVs use AI to record audio and screenshots for ads
picks.rationale: A researcher reverse-engineered his own TV and says an on-device AI model gathers screenshots, ad-skip behavior and soundbar audio for CTV ad targeting. The claim is attributed to him, and it goes straight at how CTV ad data gets sourced.
picks.excerpt: A researcher who reverse-engineered his Samsung TV says it runs an on-device AI model that collects screenshots, skipped-ad behavior and audio via connected soundbars to feed ad targeting.

picks.title: China Unveils AI Advertising Governance Framework to Tackle Fake Endorsements and Misleading Content
picks.rationale: A blue book released at the China International Advertising Festival sets a governance framework for AI-generated ads, covering multimodal detection and platform safeguards against fake AI endorsements. It shapes how AI ad creative is checked in the Chinese market.
picks.excerpt: A blue book released at the China International Advertising Festival lays out a governance framework for AI-generated ads, including multimodal detection, platform safeguards against fake AI endorsements and stronger consumer protection.
